hidden_rule_details: Pool lifetimes: 15m swings 576 5m bars (2 days), 1h swings 1440 (5 days), 15m equal highs/lows 576, Asia/London/prior NY 432, overnight 288, prior day 576, prior week 1500, 5m swings 288. A pool not taken within its life is dropped.
Swing highs/lows are fractals with N = 2, 3, 4 and 5 bars each side (all four count; strictly above the left N, >= the right N).
Equal highs/lows: two 15m N=2 swings within max(1 pt, 0.1 ATR) and 2 days, nothing between them beyond the pair by more than that.
The ATR for every threshold is ATR(14, Wilder) of the 5m bar BEFORE the hunt bar, fixed for the whole setup.
'Within 3 hours' = 36 5m bars counted from the hunt bar itself; the setup also ends at the session end or 15:30.

Resweep (Asia): either a bar trading under the pool after an earlier close back inside it, or a new extreme after a 0.5 ATR bounce at least 2 bars after the previous extreme; it must happen on a bar before the trigger bar.
Market structure shift: the close beats the LATEST 5m swing (N=2) the other way that is confirmed before the trigger bar and formed no earlier than 48 bars before the hunt; older swings do not count.
Inducement (trend): a 5m N=2 swing on the pool's side, between the pool and 1 ATR beyond it, formed in the 36 bars before the hunt and confirmed before it.
When two hunts give a signal on the same bar and side, the most obvious pool's hunt is used (score), then the latest hunt.
1h trend = sign(close of the last CLOSED clock-hour bar - EMA 50 of 1h closes); 1h bars are cut at the 18:00 session start.
2026 trades are filled and walked on 1m bars from the 5m signal close; before 2026 on 5m bars (no 1m data).

Limit at mid-candle: floor to the tick in trade direction; filled only when price trades 1 tick through within 30 minutes (30 1m bars / 6 5m bars), at the limit or a better open; no target and no BE on the fill bar.

Stops 6-80 pts; size floor(500 / (stop x $2)), max 50 micros; the 'max 1 / 2 a session' counts filled trades; a signal while a trade is open is skipped; sessions are 18:00-17:00 ET and a trade is flat at the 15:55 close.
Windows are judged on the 5m signal bar's open time (Asia = signal bar opening 18:00-01:55 ET).
